message.content: Painting the Eiffel Tower is a fairly routine maintenance job that the French authorities schedule roughly every seven years. In practice, the entire process—from surface preparation (cleaning, sandblasting, patching) through primer and two coats of protective paint—takes about **two weeks** of work. That’s why you’ll often see a small crew of painters working at night or during off‑peak hours so they can finish before the next tourist season starts.
